content.comment_body: Hello, is it possible to connect a [product_name] [article_no] to an HMI that has a BD9 RS232 communication port without using a proprietary cable?

As far as I know, connecting an HMI directly to a [product_name] using the standard cable isn't supported. Only modules with [article_no] from 0BA7 (or newer) enable Ethernet TCP/IP communication with the relevant protocol. The 0BA8.FS4 version supports Modbus TCP/IP. The 0BA6 version can only communicate with a specific operator device using a dedicated cable.

analysis.insight_summary: The user wants to connect an older [product_name] module ([article_no]) to an HMI using an RS232 port without special or proprietary cables. Responses highlight that direct connection isn't possible for this hardware version, and only later modules enable communication with HMI devices via ethernet or supported protocols. Hardware limitations and required interfaces restrict flexible integration for users with older equipment.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to easily connect and facilitate communication between their [product_name] module and HMI via RS232, preferring not to rely on proprietary cables or upgrade to newer hardware versions.
